title: Boundary-Aware Policy Learning for Agent-Orchestrated Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32238v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent-orchestrated robot systems combine the general reasoning capability of multimodal agents with the precise physical control of learned visuomotor policies. Yet such systems often fail at the moment of handoff: a policy is reliable only from a limited set of start states, while the agent may invoke it outside this region. We call this region the policy's handoff boundary. Existing whole-task policies typically have handoff boundaries that are narrow and difficult for an agent to characterize, making reliable coordination challenging. We propose Boundary-Aware Policy Learning, which explicitly shapes and then expands the handoff boundary of a visuomotor policy. First, Boundary-Explicit Training fine-tunes the policy on contact segments with diverse start poses, yielding a wide and well-defined boundary that can be communicated to the agent through a simple handoff protocol. translated_title: 面向智能体编排机器人操作的边界感知策略学习
translated_abstract: 智能体编排的机器人系统将多模态智能体的通用推理能力与学习到的视觉运动策略的精确物理控制相结合。然而，这类系统往往在策略交接的时刻失败：策略仅在一组有限的起始状态下可靠，而智能体可能会在该区域之外调用策略。我们将该区域称为策略的交接边界。现有的整任务策略通常具有狭窄且难以被智能体刻画的交接边界，使可靠的协调变得困难。我们提出边界感知策略学习，该方法显式地塑造并随后扩展视觉运动策略的交接边界。首先，边界显式训练在具有多样化起始姿态的接触片段上对策略进行微调，从而产生一个宽且定义清晰的边界，该边界可通过简单的交接协议传达给智能体。其次，边界扩展自我改进对策略进行再训练……
tldr: 该论文提出边界感知策略学习方法，通过边界显式训练塑造宽而清晰的策略交接边界，再利用边界扩展自我改进不断扩大该边界，从而解决智能体在策略可靠起始区域之外调用策略而导致的交接失败问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Boundary-Aware Policy Learning, which explicitly shapes and expands a visuomotor policy's handoff boundary through boundary-explicit training and boundary-expanding self-improvement, enabling reliable coordination between agents and policies at the handoff moment.
